chunks: And with his chain of narrators, he said: Ali (peace be upon him) said:
It is due to the covenant of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), the Unlettered, that only a believer loves me, and only a hypocrite hates me.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of loving Imam Ali in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This narration, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, establishes the 'Ahd al-Nabi' (Prophetic Covenant) as the definitive criterion for distinguishing true believers from hypocrites based on their disposition toward Imam Ali. It underscores the Shia doctrine that love for the Ahl al-Bayt is not merely a devotional act but an essential component of Iman, rooted in the Prophet's own testimony. This linkage reinforces the concept of Wilayah as the core of Islamic faith, distinguishing it from mere ritual observance.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 235 - With his chain of narrators, he said: Ali (as) said:
"It is due to the covenant of the Prophet (saw) al-Umi that only a believer loves me, and only a hypocrite hates me."
